hb-o2-binding.label: O₂ bound per gram of haemoglobin
hb-o2-binding.value: about 1.34 mL O₂ per g Hb (some papers use 1.39)

p50-normal.label: Standard P50 of adult blood
p50-normal.value: about 26–27 mmHg (26.86 mmHg at pH 7.4 and 37 °C)

hbmass-vo2max-slope.label: VO₂max per gram of total haemoglobin mass
hbmass-vo2max-slope.value: about 4 mL·min⁻¹ per g when one person's Hb mass is changed (estimates range 3–4)

o2-extraction-max.label: O₂ extraction fraction at VO₂max
o2-extraction-max.value: systemic up to about 90%; leg up to about 90–95% in trained people
